project_summary.summary: The Spring Pet Clinic is a comprehensive web application built using Java, leveraging the Spring Framework for its robust features and scalability. The project showcases a microservices-based architecture, with multiple layers of design principles adhered to. It serves as a prime example of a well-structured web application with emphasis on testing, logging, security, and deployment practices.

layers: Presentation Layer (Web), Business Logic Layer, Data Access Layer
design_principles: Separation of Concerns, Single Responsibility Principle, Dependency Inversion Principle

key_features: User Management, Pet Registration, Veterinary Services, Payment Processing

development_practices.testing: Unit testing and integration testing using JUnit and TestNG
development_practices.security: Spring Security for authentication and authorization

code_quality.organization: Well-organized codebase with clear separation of concerns
code_quality.maintainability: High maintainability due to modular design and clear interfaces

infrastructure.deployment: Containerized using Docker and deployed on Kubernetes
infrastructure.scalability: Horizontal scaling using load balancers and multiple instances
